newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian railway auction draws a single bidder.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian railway auction draws a single bidder.

text.p: A single group of investors has signed up for the auction Friday of the southeast section of Brazil's federal railway network, a BNDES official said Tuesday.
The official declined to disclose the name of the consortium, but only one group -- MRS Logistica -- is known to have signed up for the auction.
The deadline for bidders to register was 1800 local/2100 GMT.
MRS Logistica comprises three steel companies -- CSN, Cosipa and Usiminas -- two mining concerns -- MBR and Ferteco -- the Interferrea transportation group and other investors.
State-owned Companhia Vale do Rio Doce, which was previously taking part in the MRS group, apparently failed to attract investors to form its own consortium.
Officials of the mining group were unavailable to clarify if the company was still participating in the MRS group.
